full_prompt_en: An elegant couple stands at the edge of a teal lake beneath an immense round golden moon. The woman wears a long flowing ocher dress that fans out toward the lower edge, while the man in a tailored dark jacket and pale trousers turns toward her in a small, formal gesture. Their figures occupy the lower right and remain slender against a broad landscape of water, low dark banks, and softly rounded pink trees. The golden disc is perfectly flat and luminous, centered behind the trees like a theatrical backdrop. Clusters of rose and mauve blossoms hang from above and wrap around its edge. Tiny boats and distant figures on the lake add scale without pulling attention from the foreground pair. The scene is a decorative Art Deco illustration with crisp silhouettes, finely controlled linework, and areas of flat, gently textured color. Pale peach, dusty pink, ocher gold, and dark teal are arranged in large graphic zones, with black used for selected outlines and depth. An ornate rectangular border encloses the picture; its dark bands carry small golden floral emblems and patterned corner details. The frame is part of the composition, balancing the central circular moon and the elongated vertical figures. There is little naturalistic shadow or atmospheric perspective. Instead, overlapping planes and repeated curves create an elegant stage-like depth. The finished square image feels romantic, stylized, and luxurious, with delicate patterned accents set against broad quiet color fields.
full_prompt_zh: 一对优雅伴侣站在青绿色湖边，头顶是一轮巨大的金色圆月。女子穿着长长的赭黄色飘逸裙装，裙摆向画面下缘展开；男子穿裁剪合身的深色外套和浅色长裤，以小而正式的动作转向她。两人位于右下方，身形修长，背后是宽阔水面、低矮深色岸线和柔和圆润的粉色树木。金色圆盘平坦而明亮，居于树后，像戏剧舞台的背景。玫瑰粉与淡紫红的花簇从上方垂下，并环绕圆盘边缘。湖上的小船与远处人物提示尺度，却没有抢走前景两人的注意力。场景是一幅装饰艺术风格插画，具有清晰剪影、精细受控的线条与大片平坦而略带肌理的色面。浅桃色、灰粉、赭金与深青绿排列成大型图形区域，黑色用于局部轮廓和纵深。华丽矩形边框围住画面；深色边带包含小型金色花饰和角部纹样。边框是构图的一部分，平衡中央圆月与修长的竖向人物。画面几乎不依靠自然主义阴影或空气透视，而由重叠平面与重复曲线形成优雅的舞台式纵深。方形成品浪漫、程式化而华贵，细密纹样点缀在宽阔安静的色域之间。
style_prompt_en: An ornate Art Deco illustration language with crisp silhouettes, delicate controlled linework, and broad flat fields of gently textured color. Dusty rose, mauve, pale peach, ocher gold, dark teal, and black create a luxurious restrained palette. Large circular and elongated shapes balance one another within a formal frame. Fine floral and geometric ornament concentrates at edges and selected surfaces, while central areas stay spacious. Depth comes from overlapping planes and theatrical staging rather than realistic shadow. An integrated dark decorative border with small gold motifs gives the square image a complete, collectible print quality.
style_prompt_zh: 华丽的装饰艺术插画语言，以清晰剪影、细腻受控的线条和宽阔略带肌理的平涂色面构成。灰玫瑰色、淡紫红、浅桃、赭金、深青绿与黑色组成克制而华贵的配色。大型圆形与修长形态在正式边框内相互平衡。精细花卉和几何纹样集中于边缘及局部表面，中央区域保持宽松。纵深来自重叠平面和戏剧化陈设，而非写实阴影。带小型金色纹饰的深色一体式装饰边框，使方形图像具有完整、适合收藏的印刷品气质。
